data.body: Re-reviewing ADEVX-134's plan returned BLOCK on three findings, all accurate. The plan named run_bounded where the function is run_bounded_task, it did not list commit_and_push as the consumer that forwards allowed_paths to stage, and its acceptance criteria covered only the CommitPushRequest call sites while run_bounded_task calls materializer.stage directly at bounded_task_pipeline.py:226. That last one was a true coverage gap, the line was changed with no test behind it.
